en_title: Xbox Project Helix Isn't a PC After All
cn_title: XBOX Project Helix终究不是一台PC
opus_summary: 微软XBOX次世代业务副总裁Jason Ronald表示，Project Helix是一款也能运行PC游戏的主机，而非能玩主机游戏的PC。该项目旨在方便玩家访问游戏，同时为核心玩家提供设置和性能自定义选项。Ronald还提到，微软正关注神经渲染等技术。

paragraphs.en: Ever since Microsoft first teased its next-generation console/PC hybrid last year, there's been a lot of speculation on what Project Helix even is. And while that speculation is going to continue until Microsoft actually reveals the next-gen Xbox, the company has shed a bit more light on what we can expect.
paragraphs.cn: 自从微软去年首次预告其下一代主机与PC混合设备以来，人们一直在猜测Project Helix究竟是什么。虽然这种猜测将持续到微软真正公布下一代XBOX，但该公司已经进一步透露了我们可以期待些什么。

paragraphs.en: As part of its 25th anniversary celebration, Microsoft put out a special "Xbox 25th Anniversary Magazine" that covered everything from the new Xbox Nano controller to World of Warcraft Forever . But the issue also had a huge story on "The Soul of Project Helix" where Xbox VP of Next Generation (that's a real job title) Jason Ronald gave a bit more detail on what Helix actually is.
paragraphs.cn: 作为25周年庆祝活动的一部分，微软推出了一期特别版《XBOX 25周年杂志》，内容涵盖从新款XBOX Nano手柄到《魔兽世界Forever》的方方面面。但这期杂志还刊登了一篇题为「Project Helix的灵魂」的长篇报道，XBOX下一代产品副总裁（这确实是一个真实的职位名称）Jason Ronald在其中进一步介绍了Helix究竟是什么。

paragraphs.en: Back when Sarah Bond revealed the partnership behind the "next generation hardware," she emphasized that Xbox was working with the Windows team to make the desktop OS "the number one platform for gaming." Ever since then, the assumption was that Helix would be something akin to a gaming PC . But in the Xbox 25th Anniversary Magazine, Ronald states clearly that "Helix is designed to be a console that is also capable of playing games from your PC. It is not a PC that can also play console games."
paragraphs.cn: 当初Sarah Bond公布「下一代硬件」背后的合作关系时，她强调XBOX正与Windows团队合作，将这款桌面操作系统打造成「游戏第一平台」。从那时起，人们便认为Helix会是类似游戏PC的设备。但在《XBOX 25周年杂志》中，Ronald明确表示：「Helix被设计成一台也能玩你PC游戏的主机。它不是一台也能玩主机游戏的PC。」

paragraphs.en: The goal, instead, is "making it easy, intuitive and instant to access my games." But while the focus is on creating a console, Ronald still says "if you're a hardcore gamer or a power user who wants to have that deeper level of customizability across settings and performance options, you can absolutely go do it."
paragraphs.cn: 相反，目标是「让我能够轻松、直观、即时地访问自己的游戏」。不过，尽管重点是打造一台主机，Ronald仍表示：「如果你是一名核心玩家或高级用户，希望能够对设置和性能选项进行更深层次的自定义，你完全可以这么做。」

paragraphs.en: It's impossible to tell exactly what Ronald is describing, here, though. Because Project Helix will be able to run PC games, there is a certain amount of freedom that it has to give users, otherwise Microsoft could unintentionally lock players out from parts of their game library, especially on some of the lesser-known PC game platforms. It doesn't sound like Microsoft wants to stop anyone from playing any of their games. Instead, Ronald said he wants to "remove the arbitrary constraints between console and PC games."
paragraphs.cn: 不过，目前无法确切判断Ronald在这里描述的是什么。由于Project Helix能够运行PC游戏，它必须给予用户一定程度的自由，否则微软可能会无意中使玩家无法访问自己游戏库中的部分游戏，尤其是一些较不知名的PC游戏平台上的游戏。听起来微软并不想阻止任何人游玩自己的任何游戏。相反，Ronald表示，他希望「消除主机游戏与PC游戏之间人为设定的限制」。

paragraphs.en: In reality, the Project Helix operating system is probably going to be some kind of branch off of Windows 11, and is going to take some of the DNA from the ROG Xbox Ally X. As Ronald puts it, "The ROG Xbox Ally was really an opportunity for us to learn alongside our player base with a lot of these concepts and the ideas that we had: being able to play libraries from across multiple different storefronts, understanding how PC games and console games can show up together in a unified library."
paragraphs.cn: 实际上，Project Helix的操作系统很可能会是某种基于Windows 11的分支，并继承ROG XBOX Ally X的部分基因。正如Ronald所说：「ROG XBOX Ally确实为我们提供了一个机会，让我们能够围绕许多已有的概念和想法与玩家群体共同学习：能够游玩来自多个不同商店的游戏库，了解PC游戏和主机游戏如何共同出现在一个统一的游戏库中。」

paragraphs.en: I have used the Xbox Ally X a ton over the last year, and while a lot of the bones of a console-like experience are there, I'm not sure it'll ever fully translate to the kind of polish you see on the Xbox Series X homepage. And Ronald is aware of that, too.
paragraphs.cn: 过去一年里，我大量使用了XBOX Ally X，虽然它已经具备了许多类似主机体验的基本要素，但我不确定它能否真正达到XBOX Series X主页那样的完善程度。Ronald也意识到了这一点。

paragraphs.en: "The feedback that we've gotten from players has fundamentally informed and altered our plans of how it actually shows up in a future console," Ronald said. "Players shared where we met the mark and areas we needed to improve or approach differently. So absolutely, we view the Ally as a precursor to what we're doing with Helix – but it's informed by a lot of the design concepts we have for Helix."
paragraphs.cn: Ronald说：「我们从玩家那里获得的反馈，从根本上影响并改变了我们关于它将如何在未来主机上实际呈现的计划。玩家分享了我们做得好的地方，以及我们需要改进或换一种方式处理的方面。所以毫无疑问，我们将Ally视为Helix项目的先行产品——但它也借鉴了我们为Helix制定的许多设计理念。」

paragraphs.en: The biggest concern for the next generation of consoles isn't really which operating system they're running on, or whether you can run Excel – the question is the pricing, and it's not looking pretty. While Ronald does try to talk around the prices, it still doesn't sound like Project Helix is going to be especially affordable.
paragraphs.cn: 对下一代主机而言，最大的担忧其实不是它们运行什么操作系统，也不是能否运行Excel——问题在于定价，而情况看起来并不乐观。尽管Ronald确实试图绕开价格问题，但听起来Project Helix仍不会特别便宜。

paragraphs.en: "It's definitely a challenging time," he continued, "but as a system and platform designer it's also one of the most exciting times, because we have to invent entirely new technology to continue to advance the state-of-the-art while also continuing to make things accessible and affordable." I guess we'll see just how "accessible and affordable" the console is when it actually gets unveiled – however long that's going to take.
paragraphs.cn: 他接着说：「现在绝对是一个充满挑战的时期，但作为系统和平台设计者，这也是最令人兴奋的时期之一，因为我们必须发明全新的技术，才能继续推动最先进技术的发展，同时继续让产品易于获得且价格实惠。」我想，等到这台主机真正公布时，我们就会知道它究竟有多「易于获得且价格实惠」——不管那还要等多久。

paragraphs.en: It also seems like Microsoft is using the RAM crisis to justify the need for neural rendering in Project Helix, as well. When talking about price, Ronald says, "This is a big reason why we're really focused on advancements like neural rendering, because it's an entirely new way to generate a frame without requiring more computational horsepower, additional memory, and things like that."
paragraphs.cn: 微软似乎也在用内存危机来说明Project Helix需要神经渲染的理由。谈到价格时，Ronald说：「这是我们高度重视神经渲染等进步的一大原因，因为这是一种全新的帧生成方式，不需要更多算力、额外内存之类的东西。」

paragraphs.en: For the uninitiated, Nvidia's DLSS 5 is a major example of neural rendering tech that's actually made it to mainstream games like NBA 2K27 and Hogwarts Legacy. The idea is to improve visual quality in games by using AI to enhance images within the rendering pipeline. And it sure sounds like that tech is coming to the next-generation Xbox in one way or another.
paragraphs.cn: 对于不了解的人来说，Nvidia的DLSS 5是神经渲染技术的一个重要例子，它已经实际应用于《NBA 2K27》和《霍格沃茨之遗》等主流游戏。这项技术的思路是在渲染流程中利用AI增强图像，从而提高游戏的画面质量。而听起来，这项技术肯定会以某种方式登陆下一代XBOX。

paragraphs.en: My hope is that they keep it optional. No matter how you feel about DLSS 5, it does have a massive impact on performance while altering the way a game looks. Luckily, in the official implementations so far, it's been a relatively minor change, but there are definitely some modders who have pushed the technology to comical levels.
paragraphs.cn: 我希望他们保留将其设为可选项。不管你对DLSS 5有何看法，它在改变游戏画面观感的同时，确实会对性能产生巨大影响。幸运的是，在迄今为止的官方实现中，画面变化相对较小，但确实有一些模组制作者将这项技术发挥到了滑稽的程度。

paragraphs.en: With the way that graphics tech is moving lately, there's no telling what Project Helix will be capable of until it's actually in our hands. I hope that Microsoft does go for an operating system that feels at home on a TV. I was worried that it would just lean on the Xbox full screen experience, and it just isn't there yet. At least it sounds like no matter how the OS feels to navigate with a controller, it's still focused on giving people finer controls over how the system runs. And if Microsoft plans to lean on tech like neural rendering and frame generation, that's going to be more important than ever.
paragraphs.cn: 鉴于图形技术近期的发展趋势，在Project Helix真正到我们手中之前，无法断言它能做到什么。我希望微软确实会选择一款在电视上使用起来得心应手的操作系统。我曾担心它只会依赖XBOX全屏体验，而那种体验还不够完善。至少听起来，无论用手柄操作该系统的体验如何，它仍然着重于让人们更精细地控制系统的运行方式。而如果微软打算依赖神经渲染和帧生成之类的技术，这一点将比以往任何时候都更加重要。
